_about: The comparison forms the provider confirmed (spec 3.3, 4.2, 4.2.1), kept by the adopting system. Not part of the MCP tool definition. Each entry is one labelled line of a tool's description, word for word, and the form the gate compares it in: a measurement and a JSON Schema its value must satisfy. The line itself names how it is checked ("as shown by the order status"); the form is that method, translated and confirmed by the provider. A line that is not here word for word is not confirmed: it is unverified and goes back to the provider, so a reworded line voids its own confirmation.
